population.basis: the explicit member list below, declared at the candidate; not a live glob
population.excludedReason: the records this item emits are excluded so the scan cannot depend on its own bytes
population.globSemantics: tracked files matched with fnmatch.fnmatchcase; '*' matches across '/'
population.growthPolicy: a later verification re-hashes every member and reports a glob match that is not a member as NEW_SINCE_RECORD, counted separately; growth never changes this count, and a removed or changed member is refused with PH_REFUSED_POPULATION_DRIFT
